newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INCE SAVES INTERNAZIONALE WITH LATE EQUALISER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INCE SAVES INTERNAZIONALE WITH LATE EQUALISER.

text.p: England's Paul Ince saved Internazionale on Saturday with a late equaliser to force a 2-2 draw with Fiorentina.

Inter, riding high after a 3-0 rout of European champions Juventus in the Italian Cup this week, were brought back to reality by a gritty Fiorentina who nearly stole three points from the Italian league leaders.
Brazilian-born Luis Oliveira, who plays for Belgium, put the Florence club on top just before halftime and again in the 65th minute after Maurizio Ganz levelled in the 50th.
Argentina's Gabriel Batistuta set up both goals for Oliveira on the counter-attack, a tactic Fiorentina fully exploited on a rain-soaked pitch that disrupted Inter's attacks.

Inter, already missing Chilean marksman Ivan Zamorano and striker Marco Branca, appeared to have reached the end of the line when France playmaker Youri Djorkaeff hobbled off injured 10 minutes from time.
But a gutsy Ince, who scored against Juventus, beat Italy goalkeeper Francesco Toldo with an angled blast from the corner of the area in the 83rd minute.
Inter now lead Vicenza by two points and Juventus by three, but the gap can be cut on Sunday when the rest of the league returns to action.
